Microsoft Ignite opens November 17 at the Moscone Center in San Francisco, featuring keynotes from CEO Satya Nadella and commercial business CEO Judson Althoff.

While last year's event showcased advanced Windows AI agent features and connectors, none have reached stable Windows 11 releases or current Insider builds.

The catalog features roughly 1,500 sessions covering Windows quality, MXC containers, Windows 365…
